family.description: Domain occurs as one or more copies in bacterial and eukaryotic proteins. These are membrane proteins of four TM regions, two appearing in each of the two copies when both are present. Many of the latter members also carry the sodium/calcium exchanger protein family [pfam:PF01699], which have multipass membrane regions.
family.name: Inner membrane component domain
